qualityReview.identity: Preserves ivory and gold botanical armor, root limbs, golden seed face, jade leaf shield and squat protective silhouette.
qualityReview.scene: Mossy rooted threshold, receding monumental arches and foreground roots form clear three-plane depth; sunlight and contact shadows integrate character.
qualityReview.composition: Face and central shield detail are in upper 65 percent; 3:4 portrait full bleed; background remains readable around silhouette.
qualityReview.constraints: No text, frame, UI, logo or watermark seen. Opaque output.
caveats: Fine foliage detail is dense at full resolution; important forms remain broad and distinct for thumbnail cropping.
